meta.title: Browser debugging
meta.description: Two browser tool sets. mcp__chrome__* reads and debugs your own running Chrome through the companion extension "DSH Browser Bridge" (chrome.debugger plus a local WebSocket on 127.0.0.1:17321 that accepts only that extension): list and take over tabs, snapshots, screenshots, clicks and typing, console, network requests, JavaScript evaluation and raw CDP commands. First use: open chrome://extensions, turn on Developer mode, choose Load unpacked and pick the extension folder in the plugin directory; the toolbar badge shows ON when connected. mcp__browser__* launches a separate Chrome profile (~/.dsh/browser-devtools) for isolated debugging. Page contents are sent to the model. Disable the plugin to remove the tools.
